metadata.title: The Phantom Promotion
metadata.subtitle: After 2 years doing the Director's job, the VP promoted his 24-year-old nephew—and told me to hand over my VIP clients.

nodes.text: 09:30 AM · Company-wide email drops: "Welcome our new Account Director—Tyler Vance!" Your phone pings.
Hey {{player_name}}! Uncle said you’re super organized. Send me all your VIP client phone numbers and renewal decks by noon, k?
Mr. Vance, you put in writing last December that hitting $4M revenue guaranteed me the Director seat. I hit $5.2M.
Haha don’t worry Tyler, {{player_name}} is way too loyal to ever quit—they’ll do all the hard work while you take the title.
Let’s be a team player, {{player_name}}. Tyler brings "fresh executive energy." Hand over the Kapoor $3M renewal at 2 PM.

nodes.transcript: [warm, sharp] {{player_name}}, I just saw the press release. Who is this Tyler kid? My contract renewal is with YOU—if you're leaving, tell me where you're going.

nodes.prompt: A rival firm offered you VP Sales last week. What do you do before 2 PM?

options.label: Sign the rival VP offer & prep resignation
options.player_reply_text: Ms. Kapoor, let’s have coffee after 2 PM. I have exciting news about my next chapter.

options.label: Let Tyler run the 2 PM compliance Q&A solo
options.player_reply_text: Actually, Ms. Kapoor—ask Tyler about the EU data compliance addendum at 2 PM. Watch what happens.

nodes.text: Count me in. And I’ll pause signing my $3M renewal until after our coffee.
TRAP SET: Ms. Kapoor smiles and agrees—AND you sign the rival VP offer with a 45% pay bump at 11:00 AM!
Oh, this 2 PM meeting is going to be pure theater. See you soon, VP {{player_name}}.
Yo {{player_name}}, I didn’t read the slides lol—just sit next to me and whisper the answers if Kapoor asks anything hard.

nodes.headline: The $3 Million Handover
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 2: Mr. Vance introduces Tyler as the "genius" behind the account—and you slide your resignation across the table.

nodes.text: 02:02 PM · Client Boardroom. Ms. Kapoor sits across from Mr. Vance and Tyler.
Ms. Kapoor, our new Director Tyler will personally oversee your $3M renewal starting today!
Wonderful. Tyler, walk me through how you’re restructuring our Tier-3 SLA penalties under the new EU regulation.
{{player_name}} HELP!! What the heck is an SLA?! Answer for me!!
Uh... we’ll totally synergize the... cloud vibes? {{player_name}}, jump in!

nodes.prompt: Mr. Vance glares at you to rescue his nephew. Drop the mic.

options.label: Hand over your resignation & stand up
options.player_reply_text: Sorry, Tyler—I’m not qualified to answer for a Director. Here is my immediate resignation, Mr. Vance.

options.label: Announce your VP role & watch Kapoor follow
options.player_reply_text: Actually, I start Monday as VP at Meridian Group. Enjoy the fresh executive energy, Mr. Vance.

nodes.text: Ms. Kapoor closes her pen immediately: "Without {{player_name}}, we are putting this $3M contract out to bid."
CLIENT WALKOUT: Ms. Kapoor stands up beside you: "Send me Meridian’s proposal Monday morning, {{player_name}}!"
WAIT! {{player_name}}! I’ll match their offer! I’ll make YOU Director right now!

nodes.transcript: [laughing in the elevator] Best business meeting I have attended all year. Drinks on me!

nodes.headline: Know Your Worth
nodes.teaser_text: By Friday, four more of your former teammates text asking if Meridian is hiring—and Mr. Vance is summoned to an emergency board review.

nodes.text: 9:10 AM · Meridian Offices. Four former teammates want to join you—and Mr. Vance just sent a legal threat.
{{player_name}}, our legal team just filed a non-solicit cease-and-desist against you! You illegally poached Ms. Kapoor and my sales staff!
Nice try, Mr. Vance. Ms. Kapoor called Meridian herself after Tyler missed her launch deadline—and I never signed a non-solicit.

nodes.caption: BOGUS LEGAL THREAT · Unsigned draft non-compete attached by Vance—contradicted by Ms. Kapoor’s termination notice.

nodes.text: Oh, this is rich! Vance emailed my CFO claiming YOU were fired for "performance issues"—so I just forwarded his email straight to his Board Chair!
Uncle Vance I accidentally deleted the Q4 client renewal sheet—

nodes.transcript: [laughing] {{player_name}}, wait till you hear this—Tyler just sent my team a rival client’s confidential pricing deck by mistake! He CC’d the entire distribution list!

nodes.prompt: Vance’s emergency board review starts at 11 AM! How do you respond to his cease-and-desist?

options.label: Reply with Meridian’s counsel & zero fear
options.player_reply_text: Meridian’s general counsel just replied: drop the defamation email by noon or we sue YOU for tortious interference.

options.label: Also demand your 2 years of unpaid bonuses
options.player_reply_text: Since we’re involving HR and the Board, let’s also audit the $64,000 in Director commissions you withheld from me over two years!

nodes.text: LEGAL BACKFIRE: Vance’s own company lawyer orders him to retract the cease-and-desist immediately!
BOMBSHELL ADDED: The Board Chair adds your $64K commission claim directly to Vance’s 11 AM review agenda!
Hey {{player_name}}… any chance you can still send me those client onboarding templates? Uncle Vance is yelling at me.
Sorry Tyler—those templates come with a Director’s salary. Good luck at the 11 AM review.

nodes.headline: Where Did Your Commissions Go?
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 4: Discover who actually pocketed the $64,000 in bonuses your team earned.

nodes.text: 10:50 AM · Meridian Glass Office. Ten minutes before Mr. Vance faces the Board.
Hold on, {{player_name}}! If you drop the commission audit before 11 AM, I’ll authorize a $15K goodwill payout right now!
Funny how a man who claimed I had "performance issues" suddenly wants to pay me $15K to stay quiet.
Guess what your old payroll friend just leaked to the Board? Vance reclassified your $64K Director commissions as a "Signing Bonus"—for TYLER!
If the Chair sees Tyler’s $64K signing bonus came from {{player_name}}’s deals—
Wait—Uncle Vance, you told me that $64K bonus was standard for new Directors! I already spent half of it on a watch and a lease!

nodes.transcript: [door clicking open] My CFO just got off the phone with their Board Chair—they suspended Vance’s corporate card AND pulled the full commission ledger into the 11 AM meeting!

nodes.prompt: The Board Chair calls you directly asking for your written statement! What do you include?

options.label: Submit 2 years of signed client deal logs
options.player_reply_text: Sending every signed VIP contract, email trail, and the exact commission formula Vance promised me.

options.label: Include your 4 teammates’ withheld bonuses
options.player_reply_text: Submitting my deal logs PLUS the withheld Q3 bonuses owed to all four teammates who carried Vance’s department!

nodes.text: OPEN AND SHUT: The Board verifies every deal within minutes—confirming Vance diverted your bonuses to his nephew.
FULL RESTITUTION: The Board orders immediate back-pay for YOU and all four teammates—taken straight from Vance’s exit package!
You promoted nepotism over merit, Mr. Vance. Now enjoy the board review.
Security just walked into the conference room… Tyler, why did you admit spending the bonus in writing?!

nodes.headline: The Nepotism Ledger
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 5: Watch the commission payout land in your account as Meridian hands you your own division.

nodes.text: 3:30 PM · Meridian Conference Room. Your phone chimes with a bank alert—and four familiar faces walk in.
Breaking news from your old tower: Mr. Vance was fired FOR CAUSE at noon—and Tyler was escorted out right behind him!

nodes.caption: BACK-PAY CLEARED · $64,000 withheld Director commissions wired in full per Board restitution order.

nodes.text: Are you satisfied?! Twenty years of my reputation gone in one afternoon!
You built that reputation on my two years of unpaid work and destroyed it yourself the second you handed my seat to your nephew.
Now I have to return the leased BMW and pay back the signing bonus—

nodes.transcript: [smiling] Even better news, {{player_name}}! My board just approved DOUBLING our annual contract with Meridian—strictly under YOUR new division!

nodes.prompt: Meridian’s CEO promotes you to VP of Enterprise Sales! Who do you hire first?

options.label: Hire all 4 loyal former teammates
options.player_reply_text: Signing offer letters for all four of my former teammates right now—with transparent commission tiers!

options.label: Hire all 4 + add team revenue-share
options.player_reply_text: Bring all four aboard with 20% raises AND a shared quarterly revenue pool—nobody ever gets skipped again!

nodes.text: DREAM TEAM REUNITED: All four accept on the spot—bringing zero drama and 100% elite execution.
UNSTOPPABLE DIVISION: Your new team closes $4M in pipeline before the end of the first month!
From phantom promotion to real VP in one week. Best comeback I’ve ever witnessed!
Know your worth—and never train your own replacement for free.

nodes.headline: The Real VP Takes The Floor
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 6 (Finale): Kick off Meridian’s biggest quarter with Ms. Kapoor and your reunited dream team.

nodes.text: One Month Later · Meridian Sky Lounge. Your new VP nameplate shines as Q1 numbers hit 180% of target.
Our rollout with your new team finished TEN days early! Best partnership we’ve ever signed, VP {{player_name}}!
Easy when you have the real team doing the work—and getting paid what they actually earned.
Uh… hey {{player_name}}, I saw Meridian is hiring entry-level sales reps. Any chance—
Three recruiters turned me down after the board review leaked—

nodes.transcript: [bursting into laughter] Did Tyler seriously just apply to work UNDER you?! Frame that text message right next to your VP award!

nodes.text: Already sent him the standard public careers link. Merit only in this department.

nodes.prompt: Your closing toast at the Meridian Q1 celebration:

options.label: Toast to merit, respect & zero nepotism
options.player_reply_text: To never waiting for permission to claim the seat you already earned!

options.label: Publish transparent promotion bands for all
options.player_reply_text: And starting today, every role in my division has clear, written promotion metrics—no phantom promises ever again!

nodes.text: STANDING TOAST: Your four teammates and Ms. Kapoor raise their glasses as the skyline lights up.
TOP EMPLOYER: Your division’s retention hits 100%, and top closers across the city beg to join your roster.
Cheers to the real Director—now VP—{{player_name}}!
Just getting started, Ms. Kapoor. Let’s double Q2 too.

nodes.headline: FINALE · Worth Every Penny
nodes.teaser_text: You walked away from a phantom promotion, reclaimed your commissions, and built an unstoppable division.
